productArea.name: Releases and tags
productArea.scope: Search, create, edit, publish, and delete releases and tags, including drafts, prereleases, attachments, external assets, feeds, source archives, and tag details. Repository file editing, pull request reviews, and Actions are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Releases to inspect release lists, feeds, publication, and assets. Create a disposable release if none exists.
Choose Tags to inspect the seeded v1.0.0 tag, tag details, and its New Release link.
Choose New Release to select a tag and configure its title, notes, assets, and publication.
